results.title: Apple Launches Health AI Study with 200,000 Participants to Test Medical Chatbots | KuCoin
results.description: The company announced the Apple Health AI Usage Study on November 15, 2026, in partnership with OpenEvidence, a clinical AI platform built for healthcare professionals. Eligible participants must be 21 or older, and enrollment opened the same day as the announcement, with the app already available to download.
